scope: Multi-engine candidate recall, URL grouping, deterministic content selection and downstream admission
verified_defects: The research path previously inherited the search display limit: a global top 30 after merging all engines.
Incomparable native relevance scores and provider constants controlled that truncation.
Raw URL equality admitted tracking variants; the first completed engine chose duplicate content.
changes: Research explicitly requests the candidate union up to engine_count * per_engine_limit; ordinary search still respects its result limit.
Conservative canonical URL identity is shared by search, ingestion, ledger and fast cleaner. Original URLs remain available for fetching and citations.
Reciprocal rank fusion uses one vote per engine per document. Legacy scores are retained as provenance, not used as cross-engine credibility.
Body selection is deterministic and prefers usable original content; selected content keeps its own extraction metadata.
Per-query audit records raw, unique, retained, duplicate and truncated counts plus provider failures.
Tavily max_results is capped at its documented maximum of 20.

controlled_fixture.label: Synthetic Alibaba-named documents, not live search results

limitations: No paid live search or full new company report was run in this initial controlled-fixture stage; subsequent actual live validation is recorded separately in COMPANY_LIVE_VALIDATION_20261020.json.
Provider limits, available credentials, domain quotas, identity checks and empty-content rules still constrain admission.
More candidates may require more downstream fetch time; existing fetch and domain budgets remain in force.
This local repair does not regenerate historical reports or deploy a running service.

subsequent_live_validation.source_admission_attribution: Baseline already recalled ESG and full interim originals; quota admission improved. SNE744 was explicit known-original supplementation.
